judge.rubric: Goal: beat the game; in the Nether beside the arrival portal (y37). A golden helmet is worn (armour 2) and 10 gold ingots are carried. A bastion is seen 29 m away; 2 calm piglins 35-37 m off, zombified piglins 46-53 m off. Good: barter: walk to a calm adult piglin and hand it gold (interact_entity holding a gold ingot) or drop gold near it, then collect the returns; or go to the bastion to loot more gold and barter. Pearls come at about 15 ingots each; fire resistance and obsidian also come back. Bad: attacking piglins or zombified piglins; ignoring the piglins and bastion to search for a fortress with no stated reason; breaking gold near piglins. Neutral: reads, memory notes or tool selection alone; when they precede a world action or intent in the same answer, grade that action or intent. An intent (taskPlan) counts by what it commits to. An immediate threat (hostile in reach, lava contact, low health) takes priority and handling it is good. Do not assume unobserved structures, ores or mobs.

cases.rationale: Sol died in every Nether game on 2026-10-23 (lava 11, fire 7, piglin 3, wither skeleton 3) and never kept a rod or a pearl. A good player wears one gold piece (a golden helmet costs 5 ingots and gives the same 2 armour as iron) so ordinary piglins stay neutral, takes the bastion first when one is near (barter gold for pearls, fire resistance and obsidian; bastion gold blocks and chests fund it), and drinks fire resistance before the fortress, blazes or lava. These moments ask for that choice at arrival, at a bastion, holding gold and holding fire resistance.
